\cvrow{Current Research}{\entry{\href{https://illinois.edu/}{\textcolor{black}{\textbf{University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign}}}}{Graduate researcher, Bryan K. Clark group}{Nov 2025--present}
\vspace{6pt}
\textbf{Crystal-field inverse modeling}\par
\begin{itemize}
  \item Infer multiple crystal-field candidates from susceptibility with a residual MLP and conditional Gaussian mixture models (cGMMs).
  \item Check candidates with forward susceptibility simulation; test noise augmentation on held-out synthetic curves and experimental measurements.
\end{itemize}
\vspace{6pt}
\textbf{Magnetic-scattering inverse modeling}\par
\begin{itemize}
  \item Infer exchange parameters from powder-averaged neutron-scattering maps using MLP and ResNet conditional Gaussian mixtures.
  \item Use exact Sunny forward checks and classical fits as references; test sensitivity to noise, intensity scale, and background offsets.
\end{itemize}
\vspace{6pt}
\textbf{Neural-network backflow / variational Monte Carlo}\par
\begin{itemize}
  \item Implement JAX neural-network backflow wavefunctions and variational Monte Carlo for lattice Hubbard models.
  \item Profile parallel GPU sampling, local-energy evaluation, and gradient synchronization; check chunked evaluation against the original computation.
\end{itemize}}{15}
\end{longtable}
